name: Punic Town of Kerkuane and its Necropolis
description: Kerkuane is a Phoenician-Punic town on the coast of Tunisia's Cap Bon peninsula, and it is the only one of its kind to survive. It was probably abandoned around 250 B.C. during the First Punic War and never rebuilt by the Romans, so its streets and standard-plan houses remain. Nearby tombs yielded a painted wooden sarcophagus carved as a goddess, now in the site museum.
